caption_used: (b) Agency A. The distribution of task types across turns in verified Wildchat journalist-LLM conversations reveals a dominant focus on article generation, which accounts for approximately 83% of tasks. Headline generation, while less frequent, still represents a significant portion at roughly 28% of the total.
